$comment: Single source of truth. Tailwind reads this for web; React Native reads it for mobile. Never hardcode a value that lives here. Visual identity v2 (14 Oct 2026): derived from design-reference/redesign/04-laboratoire.html (light) and 02-noir-absolu.html (dark).
$direction: two themes, one layout — LIGHT 'Laboratoire' (putty and paper, sepia ink, one olive accent; the default) and DARK 'Noir' (black and bone, no colour accent). Decided by the founder 14 Oct 2026, DECISION_REGISTER FD-1.

color.$theme: DARK — 'Noir'. Black, bone and greys. There is NO colour accent: the accent role is bone, so emphasis comes from weight, scale and the photograph, never from a hue.
color.$dangerNote: Errors and refusals. Its own token because the form-error colour was once the HEART note-tier colour reused in seven files — a palette entry doing a job it was never chosen for.

$colorLightNote: The LIGHT theme's primitives — 'Laboratoire'. A separate object rather than a second value beside each dark one, because the two palettes are different colours, not the same colours at different lightnesses. Roles are assembled from both objects in theme.ts; no component ever names a primitive.

$contrastNotesLight.stone-on-putty: 4.74:1 — smallest labels; putty is the DARKEST surface a label sits on, so it is the binding one
$contrastNotesLight.olive-on-putty: 5.8:1 — the one accent, as text and hairlines
$contrastNotesLight.paper-on-olive: 6.6:1 — text printed on the olive fill
$contrastNotesLight.rule: On paper the floor is approached from ABOVE: anything LIGHTER than #67615A loses contrast. #6E675D is already 4.33:1 on putty.

$contrastNotes.faint-on-noir: 5.8:1 — smallest labels; 4.60:1 on l3, which is the binding one
$contrastNotes.rule: The floor is set by the LIGHTEST surface a label may be printed on, not by the page. Never introduce a grey darker than #8F8A84 on Noir.

$noteTierNote: The pyramid tiers, per theme. `base` was #95764A, which cleared 4.5:1 on the page ground and quietly failed it at 4.43:1 on an l1 panel — the surface the pyramid is actually printed on. The assertion checked one ground and the component used the other. The values here clear the floor on EVERY surface role, including the l2 and l3 steps nothing paints on yet: a role that only works on some of the surfaces it is allowed on is a trap left for whoever uses the next one.
$stageNote: The lit stage behind the ILLUSTRATED flacon — the placeholder drawn when a listing has no photograph yet. A literal palette like scentFamily, dark in both themes because it is a drawing of a bottle in a dark room. Real photographs sit on the `plate` role instead, which follows the theme (identity v2, 14 Oct 2026).

font.$usage: Fonts follow the THEME as well as the language (identity v2, 14 Oct 2026). Light: Noto Naskh Arabic headings, IBM Plex Sans Arabic text; on the English site Newsreader headings and IBM Plex Sans Arabic's Latin glyphs for text. Labels and data (sizes, references, the specimen fields) in IBM Plex Mono — Latin only. Dark: Reem Kufi headings, Noto Kufi Arabic text; on the English site Archivo, condensed capitals for headings. ARABIC IS NEVER LETTERSPACED OR SET IN A LATIN LABEL FACE: tracking breaks the joins.

fontSize.$desktopNote: The ramp above is the PHONE ramp. From 1024px the Lg steps take over: a 33px headline on a 27-inch monitor reads as a phone screenshot, not as a maison.
fontSize.$minimumNote: HIG mobile minimum is 11pt. The 9.5 and 10.5 values are permitted ONLY for letterspaced Bodoni labels and numeric captions, never for reading text.

lineHeight.$comment: Arabic needs more leading than Latin. Set for Arabic first.

motion.$comment: Luxury motion has weight. Things settle; they never pop, bounce or spring.
motion.$rule: Nothing under 120ms — below that a transition reads as a glitch, not a move.

easing.$forbidden: No spring. No overshoot. No ease-in-back. A bouncing element reads as a consumer app instantly.

haptic.$comment: Mobile only. Subtle, meaningful, rare. Haptics on every tap is noise.

elevation.$rule: There is deliberately no shadow scale. Depth comes from value (l1 → l2 → l3) and hairlines. A drop shadow requires written justification.

size.$rule: 44pt is the hard minimum for anything tappable. A control may LOOK smaller (e.g. a 36px circle) but its hit area must be 44pt.
